note: Representative records modeled on REAL US federal/state programs, in the exact schema fetch_federal.py produces. Award figures and eligibility reflect the actual programs; close_dates are set relative to 2026-07-15 for the demo. Swap this file for live output of: python fetch_federal.py --enrich --out ../data/federal.json

grants.title: Rural Energy for America Program (REAP) — Renewable Energy & Efficiency Grants
grants.summary_plain: Helps rural small businesses and farmers pay for solar, wind, or energy-efficiency upgrades — covers up to 50% of project cost.
grants.eligibility_notes: Business must be in a rural area (under 50,000 pop). Cost-share required.

grants.title: DOE Small Business Innovation Research (SBIR) Phase I — Clean Energy
grants.summary_plain: Funds early R&D for small tech companies working on clean-energy innovations. No repayment, no equity taken.
grants.eligibility_notes: For-profit, <500 employees, majority US-owned. PI must be primarily employed by the company.

grants.title: Environmental Justice Collaborative Problem-Solving Cooperative Agreement
grants.summary_plain: Grants for nonprofits tackling environmental and public-health problems in their local community.
grants.eligibility_notes: 501(c)(3) or tribal org. Must partner with an affected community.

grants.title: CalSEED Concept Award — Early-Stage Clean Energy Startups
grants.summary_plain: $150k grant for California-based startups with an early clean-energy idea. No equity taken.
grants.eligibility_notes: Company must be based in California. Idea must be pre-commercial.

grants.title: Texas Small Business Disaster Recovery & Resilience Grant
grants.summary_plain: Helps Texas small businesses rebuild and add resilience after federally declared disasters.
grants.eligibility_notes: Must be in an eligible county with a declared disaster. Under 100 employees.

grants.title: National Electric Vehicle Infrastructure (NEVI) Formula — Charging Buildout
grants.summary_plain: Funds building public EV fast-charging stations along highway corridors.
grants.eligibility_notes: Sites must meet federal spacing/uptime standards. Cost share applies.

grants.title: SBA Women-Owned Small Business Growth Accelerator Fund
grants.summary_plain: Cash prizes for organizations that help women entrepreneurs grow, especially in STEM.
grants.eligibility_notes: Must run an accelerator/incubator supporting women founders.

grants.title: NYSERDA Commercial Energy Efficiency Retrofit Incentive
grants.summary_plain: Rebates for New York businesses that cut energy use with efficient HVAC, lighting, and controls.
grants.eligibility_notes: Facility must be in NY and a utility customer paying the SBC charge.

grants.title: Value-Added Producer Grant (VAPG)
grants.summary_plain: Helps farmers earn more by processing or marketing their raw products (e.g. turning milk into cheese).
grants.eligibility_notes: Must be an independent agricultural producer or farmer co-op. Matching funds required.

grants.title: National Endowment for the Arts — Grants for Arts Projects
grants.summary_plain: Project funding for nonprofit arts organizations — exhibitions, performances, community programs.
grants.eligibility_notes: 501(c)(3) with a 3-year arts programming history. 1:1 match required.

grants.title: Broadband Equity, Access, and Deployment (BEAD) Subgrant
grants.summary_plain: Funds building high-speed internet to unserved and underserved areas.
grants.eligibility_notes: Administered through state broadband offices; requires 25% match.

grants.title: California Competes Grant — Job Creation
grants.summary_plain: Grants for California businesses that commit to creating jobs and investing in the state.
grants.eligibility_notes: Scored on jobs created and wages. Multi-year commitment.

grants.title: EDA Regional Innovation & Manufacturing Cluster Grant (CLOSED)
grants.summary_plain: Large grants for regional coalitions building advanced-manufacturing and innovation hubs.
grants.eligibility_notes: This cycle has closed — kept to show how expired grants are flagged, not hidden.

grants.title: HUD Community Development Block Grant — Microenterprise Assistance
grants.summary_plain: Helps very small businesses (5 or fewer employees) in low-income areas with startup and growth costs.
grants.eligibility_notes: Owner income and business size limits apply. Administered by local city/county.
